# What can be condensed

The rules `/mod-compact` applies, file by file. A section is condensed only when it's
**settled** and the component's tier allows it
([SKILL.md § 1a](SKILL.md#1-check-changes-nothing)): **active**, **built** or **live** (live
or kept). Each rule names the first tier it applies to, and applies to the later ones too: an
active rule to every component, a built rule to built and live ones. Everything in § Always
stays survives word for word, whatever the rule says.

## Always stays

In every file and every tier:
- **Every file and its path,** and **every heading.** A section may shrink to one line; its
  heading stays, so links, the § references in the skills and the sections code comments name
  (`tdd.md § Golden examples`) still resolve.
- **Every header field:** `**Status:**`, `**Plan:**`, `**Verdict:**`, `**Map:**`,
  `**Coverage:**`, `**Read:**`, `**Updated:**`, `**Highest archived ID:**`…: commands decide
  stages and progress from them.
- **Every row that carries an ID,** with its ID cell as it is: questions `Q-###`; port steps
  and their tests `P3`, `P3.2`; flows `F02`, their rules, tests and build steps `R4`, `T6`,
  `B1` (`F02-R4` outside their files); screens `S01` and their steps `U1`, `B1`
  (`S01-U1`); stories `S1`; improvements `I01` and their steps `I01-S2`; the # of an order of
  work. A row can get shorter; it never goes.
- **Every status,** as it is, except a status history condensed as § Statuses below says.
- **Exact values:** a rule's exact details (constants, formats, rounding, the order the
  validations run in), messages word for word, every test's Given, Expect or Then and Worked
  out from, the legacy outputs recorded in golden examples, and every `path:line` a rule, a
  test, a trap or a blocker cites.
- **Anything still in use:** OPEN questions; `(rests on Q-###)` tags and Rests on lines;
  `to do`, `building`, `partial`, `in progress`, and a `re-check (…)` with no later `reworked`
  or `fixed`; every row of `modern.md § Work in progress`; Waits for; § In the modern
  solution; the decisions in force; the § Open questions of every file.
- **What code comments cite:** `Decision YYYY-MM-DD` (a decision row's date),
  `docs/improvements/<nn>-<topic>.md`, `docs/components/<component>/port.md`, the rule, test
  and step IDs.

## Never compacted

| File or section | Why |
|---|---|
| `docs/system.md`, except § Discovery progress | the solution on one page: every command reads it first |
| `docs/target.md` | accepted by the developer, at most 150 lines; `/mod-target <change>` revises it |
| `docs/skeleton.md` | the solution as built, and its commands |
| `docs/reports/` | regenerated by `/mod-legacy-report` and `/mod-modern-report`; never edited by hand |
| `docs/archive/questions.md` | the archived rows, word for word |
| `component.md`, except § Notes | Identity, Technology, links, § Files, § Suggested approach, § Deep-dives: the reports, `/mod-deepdive` and `/mod-implement` read them |
| the plans of an active component | they're being worked on |

## Condensed when settled

### `component.md § Notes` (active)

Read by `/mod-implement § 1` and the developer: analysis from `/mod-discover-comp "<what>"`,
and a line per answered question from `/mod-answer`.
- **Settled:** a `- YYYY-MM-DD Q-### answered: …` line (the answer is in the question bank,
  and was applied where it rested); an entry whose finding is now recorded elsewhere: a plan,
  § Files, § Suggested approach, a decision. Name where.
- **Compacted:** the answered lines become one line,
  `- Answered: Q-012 (2026-11-10), Q-031 (2026-11-12): see the question bank`; an entry
  recorded elsewhere becomes one line, its date and the request kept:
  `- 2026-11-08 "who calls the export": now in deepdive.md § Flows (F03)`.
- **Live, also:** the entries beyond the 5 most recent become one line each: the date, the
  request, the answer in a few words, and its key `path:line`.

### Statuses (built)

Steps in `port.md`, a flow's `tdd.md § Build steps`, a screen's § Steps, an improvement's
§ Steps. Read by `/mod-track`, `/mod-implement` and `/mod-answer archive`.
- **Settled:** a `done` step whose status carries more than one `reworked` or `fixed`, and no
  `re-check (…)` without a later rework or fix.
- **Compacted:** the first `done`, the latest rework or fix, and the count of the earlier
  ones, as [formats.md § Statuses](../mod-deepdive/formats.md#statuses) says:
  `done (2026-11-10) · reworked (2026-11-12): Dapper · fixed (2026-11-14): rounding · fixed (2026-11-20): null customer`
  → `done (2026-11-10) · fixed (2026-11-20): null customer (+2 earlier)`.

### `logic.md`

- **§ Coverage ledger (built):** settled when **Status:** is `complete` and every row's Read is
  `✓`. The `✓` rows go; a row whose Read names a `Q-###` stays; under the heading one line:
  `All <M> methods read ✓ (the Coverage line above has the counts).`
- **§ Walk-through (live):** settled when the flow's item is done. 3–5 lines in plain words:
  the trigger, the path from its start `path:line` to the data it writes, the external calls.
  The sequence diagram goes.
- **§ Logic map (live):** the diagram goes. The rules table stays whole.
- **Stays:** the header and Coverage lines, the rules table, § Traps, § Open questions.

### `sdd.md` (live)

Settled when the flow's item is done.
- **§ Stories:** each story becomes one line, its ID and the rules it cites:
  `**S1** The clerk saves an order (R1–R4).`
- **§ On the target:** the modern files, classes and endpoints, as a list; the prose goes.
- **Stays:** What it does for the business, § Screen behaviour, § Data and integrations and the
  side effects, § Behaviour parity (its "May differ" rows are decisions), Out of scope.

### `tdd.md` (live)

- **§ Build steps:** settled when every step is done. What to build becomes a few words; Step,
  Tests, Needs and Status stay.
- **Stays:** the Coverage line, § Tests, § Golden examples, Fakes, Pitfalls.

### `port.md` (live)

- **Step rows:** settled when the step is done. Changes and Behaviour risks become the
  essentials, a few words each, with the test IDs that pin each risk. Legacy files, Modern
  files, Needs and Status stay.
- **Stays:** § Unit tests, whole.

### `deepdive.md` (live)

- **§ File map:** settled when every item of § Order of work is done. The diagram goes; the
  table stays.
- **Stays:** the header line, § Flows, § How each file moves, § Order of work, § Open
  questions.

### `screens/<nn>-<screen>.md` (live)

Settled when every step of the screen is done.
- **§ Inventory:** the events' What it does becomes a few words. The control rows stay: they
  hold the defaults, the validations and the side-by-side checklist.
- **§ The split:** What it does becomes a few words; Goes to and Built by stay.
- **Stays:** Messages (word for word), § Steps (statuses as above), § Side-by-side check.

### `docs/improvements/<nn>-<topic>.md` (its own status)

Read by `/mod-track`, `/mod-implement` (one being built that touches the component) and the
code comments that cite its path. Settled when its **Status:** is `done` or `dropped`, whatever
the tier of the components it touched.
- **§ Where we are now:** one line: what it replaced.
- **§ Options weighed:** the table goes; the **Chosen:** and **Not chosen:** lines stay.
- **§ What we need:** one line: all done, with the names of what was created (never a secret).
- **§ Steps:** What becomes a few words; Step, Files, Tests and Status stay.
- **Stays:** the header line (a dropped one keeps its why), § Goal, § What changes, § Behaviour
  stays, § Rollback, § Questions.

### `docs/modern.md`

Read by `/mod-implement`, `/mod-track` and `/mod-modern-report`.
- **§ Target and decisions:** a row is settled when a later row of the same Area decides the
  same thing again and replaces it. The row stays, with its Area and Date (code comments cite
  `Decision YYYY-MM-DD`): its Decision in a few words, its Why `superseded by <date>`. A
  decision in force stays word for word.
- **§ Progress:** the Evidence of a built or live row that runs over a line becomes the latest
  evidence: a test run with its date, a commit or a pull request.
- **Stays:** § Plan, § Work in progress, § Improvements.

### `docs/system.md § Discovery progress`

Read by `/mod-track` and `/mod-discover` for the discovery gate.
- **Notes:** settled when the component's Deep is complete. Notes about retries left, calls
  run out or files left become `—`; any other note stays. The table stays.

### `docs/questions.md`

Never condensed: the rows that `/mod-answer § 5a` says can move go to `docs/archive/questions.md`
word for word, as its [§ 5c](../mod-answer/SKILL.md#c-archive) says.
